rules.name: Rate limit /city/:slug and /teachers/:path* (LOG only)
rules.description: Vercel Hobby usage fix item #4: caps requests/min per IP on the two busiest route groups to cut Edge Request COUNT directly (the other items in this plan cut cache-miss compute, not request count). LOG-only per the plan's own instruction -- test that Vercel actually honours a non-blocking rate-limit action before ever flipping this to deny/challenge. Distinct lever from bot_protection, which stays LOG-only by prior decision (a past incident blocked legitimate internal pg_net callers) -- this rule targets request VOLUME per IP, not traffic classification, so it does not reintroduce that risk.

rules.name: Bypass revalidate webhook
rules.description: Supabase's pg_net calls this path to purge the CDN cache on content writes. Bot Protection would flag it as non-browser traffic and challenge it, which pg_net cannot solve -- silently breaking cache invalidation. Must run before Bot Management.
